purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: ACTIVE: learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route after exact/equivalent recovery closed on protected validation.

L1_PHASE.goal: Learned host numerical recovery: build an intentional NPU-native correction/student that passes teacher/full-Vocos CPU, QNN-CPU, disjoint heldout/stress and eventually strict HTP gates. QNN CPU is reference/integration control, not HTP truth.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: A frozen learned candidate passes host numerical+structural qualification, then proceed to strict HTP device truth.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: If a single-boundary learned corrector cannot generalize on disjoint host heldout, enlarge optimization unit instead of micro-tuning rank.

L2_MECHANISM.name: BLOCK0_ADD3_LEARNED_RESIDUAL_FOUNDATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: The exact route is closed. Nonperturbing taps show the final-sensitive direction already exists by block0 Add3. A learned correction at this complete residual boundary can target total deterministic QNN-CPU error without requiring algebraic equivalence.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: First test learnability. Split is frozen before all-warm collection; no final-spectrum or warm18 hyperparameter selection. If heldout Add3 residual is not predictably low-rank, escalate to wider student.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Residual target is predictably low-rank on disjoint validation/holdout, justifying one NPU-native correction family.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: Poor heldout predictability closes single-boundary Add3 correction and triggers adjacent-block/wider student.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Can ORT Add3 - QNN Add3 be predicted from QNN Add3 state with a compact low-rank correction that generalizes across disjoint real-warm blocks?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Frozen 30/8/9 SHA split over warm1..47 with warm18 holdout-only. Collect observer-qualified QNN Add3 and candidate-own ORT Add3 once. Fit only on train; select rank/regularization only on validation Add3 metrics; open holdout once after selection.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Report singular spectrum and train/validation/holdout residual reduction. Only robust heldout improvement authorizes source-ONNX learned-branch materialization.

L4_ACTION.action: Using the frozen split and collection plan, collect QNN and ORT Add3 for warm1..47 once and SHA-lock a DATASET_MANIFEST before any fitting.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: This establishes whether the newly activated learned route has a stable target before architecture search.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and enlarge the optimization unit or route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not micro-tune; justify broader learned capacity or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_single_boundary_learned_failure: Escalate to adjacent-block/wider student rather than more rank/regularization variants.

preflight_questions: What parent task does this action advance?
Why can this learned unit plausibly correct the observed residual rather than merely fit one block?
What split protects validation/holdout from fitting?
What result closes this correction location and forces a wider student?
What data must remain excluded from fitting/selection?
